Container.Name: internet-monitor
Container.Overview: Continuously measures your internet connection: latency, jitter and packet loss to your router, your ISP's edge router and public resolvers, once a second. Detects outages and says whether the break is your LAN, your ISP's connection or further upstream. Keeps 30 days of history, sends Discord alerts and serves a web dashboard that keeps working while the internet is down.[br][br]Use host networking (the default here) so the monitor sees your real router. Keep appdata on the cache pool: the database is written once a minute.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database (about 20 MB for 30 days). Keep it on the cache pool.

Config.Name: Discord webhook URL
Config.Description: Optional. Channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks, New Webhook, Copy URL. Leave empty to turn alerts off.

Config.Name: Listen address
Config.Description: Address and port for the web UI. With host networking this is the port on your server; change it if 8765 is taken.

Config.Name: Internet targets
Config.Description: Comma-separated IPs or hostnames pinged every second. The internet counts as down when none of them answer.

Config.Name: Custom targets
Config.Description: Optional extra hosts to chart, as name=host,name2=host2. Never counted as an internet outage.

Config.Name: Gateway
Config.Description: auto, off, or your router's IP.

Config.Name: ISP edge router
Config.Description: auto (found by traceroute), off, or an IP.

Config.Name: IPv6
Config.Description: auto, on or off. With auto, IPv6 targets are used only if the server has IPv6 connectivity.

Config.Name: Outage threshold
Config.Description: How long every internet target must be unreachable before it counts as an outage.

Config.Name: Degraded: packet loss %
Config.Description: Loss over a rolling minute that counts as degraded.

Config.Name: Degraded: p95 latency (ms)
Config.Description: 95th-percentile latency over a rolling minute that counts as degraded.

Config.Name: Degraded: minimum duration
Config.Description: How long the degraded condition must last before it is reported.

Config.Name: Alert: minimum outage
Config.Description: Shorter outages are recorded but not sent to Discord.

Config.Name: Alert: batch window
Config.Description: Repeated alerts within this window are combined into one message.

Config.Name: Alert: ISP route changes
Config.Description: Send a Discord message when your ISP edge router changes.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as after opening its ping socket (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (100 = users).
